after_review.review_basis: Three independent original-resolution reviews of the final normal-renderer sheets for exposed guide, footprint overflow, hard-surface bleed, z-fighting, floating seams, and rotation discontinuity.

building_crazy_golf.rationale: The bordered course slab reaches the full 1x1 footprint at ground height in all four rotations.

building_duck_pond.rationale: The opaque pond surround covers the full 1x1 footprint; retaining replace prevents grass bleed through the water asset.

building_garage.rationale: The correctly sized garage and hardstanding fill one axis but leave a persistent exposed strip on the 0.880-cell axis; uniform scale would overflow.

building_lumber_mill.rationale: The centred fenced yard fills one axis but leaves an exposed 0.886-cell short-axis band; a grass continuation is safer than scaling the architecture.

building_members_club.rationale: The complete hardstanding and curb slab reaches the footprint boundary across all rotations.

building_nature_patch.rationale: The authored vegetated base is effectively full-cell and visually continuous to every edge.

building_nightclub.rationale: The centred terrace fills one axis but covers only 0.625 cells on the other; scaling would overflow the full axis substantially.

building_pipe_factory.rationale: The concrete industrial slab reads as full-footprint; its sub-percent bevel inset does not expose a visible untreated strip.

building_pirate_radio.rationale: The correctly sized tower compound leaves a thin but continuous exposed short-axis strip; scaling would overflow its full axis.

building_postwar_midblock.rationale: The block and base fill one axis but leave broad exposed bands on the 0.762-cell axis; uniform scale is unsafe.

building_postwar_terrace.rationale: The terrace base is effectively 1x1 and reaches the footprint outline in every rotation.

building_postwar_tower_block.rationale: The grounded concrete podium fills one axis but leaves a consistent exposed strip on the 0.829-cell axis.

building_pub.rationale: The intentionally asymmetric building, garden, and paths are correctly sized but do not provide a complete base; offset or scale would damage the composition.

building_restaurant.rationale: The paved restaurant base is grounded but leaves a repeatable 0.911-cell edge band while the other axis is already full.

building_small_a.rationale: The house and landscaped plot are correctly sized but expose a short-axis strip; the existing garden makes a grass continuation natural.

building_small_b.rationale: The shop and paved forecourt fill one axis but leave a visible 0.902-cell outer band; scaling would overflow.

building_small_c.rationale: The 2x2 tower and podium are centred but cover only 1.757 cells in depth while already spanning the full two-cell width.

building_small_d.rationale: The walled landscaped base fills one axis but leaves a visible 0.846-cell short-axis strip across rotations.

building_theatre.rationale: The correctly sized theatre fills one axis but leaves broad exposed bands on the 0.645-cell axis; uniform scale would overflow.

building_town_hall.rationale: The mandatory 2x2 checkpoint spans the full width but only 1.100 cells in depth; a footprint underlay repairs all four cells without unsafe scaling.

building_windmill.rationale: The walled grass plot fills one axis but exposes a persistent strip on its 0.907-cell near-ground axis; scaling would overflow.

grass.rationale: The purpose-built grass plane fills the 1x1 footprint exactly.

grass_trees.rationale: The integrated terrain plate is effectively full-cell and exposes no meaningful footprint strip.

grass_trees_tall.rationale: The vegetation is correctly scaled but its ground plate covers only about 0.844x0.791 cells; elevated trees already reach the full overall axis.

pavement.rationale: The full paved hardstanding covers the complete footprint and must continue replacing grass.

pavement_fountain.rationale: The paved fountain surround covers the complete footprint and must continue replacing grass.

road_corner.rationale: The road and kerb plate covers the full 1x1 footprint.

road_intersection.rationale: The intersection hard surface covers the full 1x1 footprint.

road_split.rationale: The split-road hard surface covers the full 1x1 footprint.

road_straight.rationale: The straight-road hard surface covers the full 1x1 footprint.

road_straight_lightposts.rationale: The straight-road hard surface remains full-footprint beneath its light posts.
